Title: Protected admin APIs reject the authenticated browser session with 401 / Invalid Token
Steps to Reproduce: Sign in through /login; navigate to protected admin pages; reload after the UI reports successful authentication
Expected Result: Authenticated session can load protected API data; if expired, user is clearly redirected to login and protected pages do not present stale/empty data as valid
Actual Result: Repeated protected API requests returned HTTP 401; Chat Monitor displayed Invalid Token; Blocked Addresses reported session expired; page shells remained accessible and several pages showed empty/loading state
Evidence: Browser console events at 2026-10-24 14:47–14:58Z repeatedly report 401; screenshots/snapshots captured on /chat_monitor, /ip_block, /main_market_list and report routes

Title: Player list pagination exposes pages when the filtered result set is empty
Steps to Reproduce: Enter a unique nonexistent value in User Name; click Filter; observe pagination; click Next; click Reset
Expected Result: No-match results should not show a misleading total page count; Next should be disabled at zero results; reset should restore the correct list state
Actual Result: No players found was shown while pagination read Page 1 of 10 with Next enabled; Next advanced to Page 2 of 10; after Reset, no players were shown while 10 pages remained
Evidence: Visible page snapshot after filter, next, and reset; 401 requests were also present, so backend count/data remains unverified

Title: Failed blank market submission temporarily changes displayed board count
Steps to Reproduce: With all Open a New Board fields blank, click Open the board; observe validation and board count; reload
Expected Result: Validation should prevent a write and keep the displayed board count consistent with persisted records
Actual Result: Validation warning appeared, but displayed board count changed from 0 to 1 while the list showed an incomplete placeholder board; reload restored count 0. User confirmed no market record was created. API request returned 401
Evidence: Captured warning, transient count/card snapshot, subsequent reload showing zero boards; user verified no persistent record exists
